authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner groups Khowar diyār, Kalasha/Palula deh, Kashmiri dih, Nepali dinu, Assamese diba and the widespread de-/ḍe- present/imperative series under dadāti, explaining its analogical remodeling with dēti and dēhi. These simple survey di-/de- give forms fit that family. The distinct prā preterite and suffixed past-participial forms are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Turner identifies Hindi gayā, Nepali/Kumaoni gayo and Old Gujarati gyau/giu as suppletive preterites of go from gata. These survey gV(y)- forms preserve that gone/past stem even though the elicitation gloss is simply go. Forms retaining an l expansion are assigned to the separate *gatailla branch.
